triage.summary: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks Alex to automate their cake order form so orders land in a Google Sheet and wants to know the cost.

task.title: Prepare a quote for Brown Bakery's order form automation
task.description: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks Alex to automate their cake order form to send orders to a Google Sheet and provide a price.

reply.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for reaching out. I’d be happy to discuss this and put together a quote. Could you share a little more about how your current order form works and what information you’d like captured in the Google Sheet?

Best,
Alex
